skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the structure of travel programs, organizational structures, roles, and requirements of design, operation, and tour guiding departments in travel agencies.
Explain the process and steps involved in designing tours, operating travel programs, and tour guiding.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Relationship Between Travel Companies and Suppliers/Clients
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the relationship between travel companies and suppliers/clients in various types of distribution chains.
Analyze the role, requirements, and basic content in preparing information, building content, and methods of tour explanation.
Apply skills to analyze tourist indicators, customer needs, and pricing of products.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Service Providers and Tourist Sites
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply skills to analyze service providers and tourist sites to build complete tours with reasonable prices.
Apply skills to analyze, plan operations for a travel program.
Know how to build tour explanations and plan tour guidance for a travel program.
Demonstrate the ability to update knowledge.
Identify health, ethical standards, awareness, and responsibility in learning and work.
